## Summary

Trading members are informed that pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation approved by the NCLT, Chandigarh Bench, Rudra Ecovation Limited (Transferor Company) is amalgamating into Shiva Texfabs Limited (Transferee Company). Trading in equity shares of Rudra Ecovation Limited will be suspended effective from the record date.

## Key Points

- Transferor Company: Rudra Ecovation Limited (Scrip Code: 514010)
- Transferee Company: Shiva Texfabs Limited
- Record Date: November 6, 2026
- Suspension/No Dealings Date w.e.f.: November 6, 2026
- Share Exchange Ratio: 0.213 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each of Shiva Texfabs Limited for every 1 Equity Share of Re. 1/- each held in Rudra Ecovation Limited (e.g., 213 shares for every 1,000 shares).

## Regulatory Changes

Approval of the Scheme of Amalgamation by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chandigarh Bench.

## Compliance Requirements

Trading members are requested not to deal in the equity shares of Rudra Ecovation Limited with effect from November 6, 2026.

## Important Dates

- Notice Date: November 5, 2026
- Record Date: November 6, 2026
- Suspension Effective Date: November 6, 2026

## Impact Assessment

Shareholders of Rudra Ecovation Limited will receive shares of Shiva Texfabs Limited as per the defined share swap ratio, and trading in Rudra Ecovation Limited shares is suspended due to the amalgamation.
